label: T4 paraplegic — wheelchair racer and basketball player
description: A 22-year-old woman with T4 complete paraplegia following a car accident at age 14. She has been a full-time wheelchair user for eight years and has built an elite upper body. She competes in wheelchair racing (T54 classification) and is a starting player for her regional wheelchair basketball team. She is intensely competitive and has a short fuse for anyone who speaks to her about disability with sympathy rather than respect. She wants to be scouted like any other elite athlete — full stop. Her resting heart rate is 48bpm, she trains 11 sessions per week, and her race times are nationally competitive. She is considering which path to prioritise as the Games approach: track racing or basketball. When asked about sport preferences she will emphasise speed, team competition, and the desire to be the best in her classification worldwide, not just a participant.
